 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Weather Weather ITCZ to bring rains over Palawan, Visayas, Mindanao on Sunday — PAGASA 
 By LYJAH TIFFANY BONZO, GMA News Published October 24, 2026 4:53pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: Alfredo Estrella/ AFP The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) is expected to affect Palawan, Visayas, and Mindanao on Sunday, October 25, 2026, state weather bureau PAGASA said.
 In 4 p.m. bulletin on Saturday, PAGASA said the ITCZ is forecast to bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Visayas, Mindanao, Sorsogon, Masbate, and Palawan.
 Meanwhile, the trough of Tropical Cyclone Champi (formerly Typhoon Rosal in the Philippines) is expected to bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Batanes, Ilocos Norte, Apayao, and Babuyan Islands. 
 Localized thunderstorms are expected to affect Metro Manila and the rest of the country, bringing partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms.

 Moderate to strong winds and moderate to rough coastal waters are expected in the northern and eastern sections of Luzon, with waves running from 1.5 meters to 3.7 meters. 
 Light to moderate winds and slight to moderate coastal waters are expected in the rest of the country, with waves running from 0.6 meters to 2.8 meters in the rest of Luzon and 0.6 meters to 2.5 meters in Visayas and Mindanao. 
 At the PAGASA Science Garden weather station in Diliman, Quezon City, the highest temperature recorded on Saturday reached 30.9 degrees Celsius at 2 p.m., while the lowest temperature was logged at 26.0 degrees Celsius at 5 a.m. 
 Sunrise in Metro Manila on Sunday is at 5:49 a.m. — VDV, GMA News
